'''Shimmerbird tongue robes''' were flamboyant and silk-like robes often worn by wealthy members of the [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. They were made of the [[Tongue/Legends|tongues]] of the [[Shimmerbird/Legends|shimmerbird]] species. [[Denaria Kee/Legends|Denaria Kee]], chief aide to [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], wore one often and so did Argente himself.

In the Year [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], while [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was speaking before the senate, then [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Kooriva/Legends|Kooriva]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] wore a silvery-green one by itself at one point and under a Sienna [[Cloak/Legends|Cloak]] at one point.

Passel Argente wore it again in the year [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] while conferencing and overseeing the operations on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], this time underneath a bulky brown cloak described as oily.
